name: Couchbase Lite
tagline: Embedded JSON document database with SQL++ queries, vector search and sync to Couchbase.
description: Couchbase Lite is the on-device half of Couchbase Mobile: an embedded JSON document store for iOS, Android, .NET, Java and C that queries with SQL++ (Couchbase's SQL for JSON), supports full-text and vector indexes, and replicates through Sync Gateway or Capella App Services to a Couchbase Server cluster, as well as peer-to-peer between devices. It is the most enterprise-ready option for offline-first apps that need conflict handling, per-channel access control and a supported vendor. The trade-off is lock-in to the Couchbase backend and an Enterprise Edition that holds several important features.

license.name: Apache-2.0 / BSL 1.1 Community Edition; commercial Enterprise Edition

pricing.notes: Community Edition is free; Enterprise Edition (encryption, vector search, P2P sync, support) is sold with Couchbase subscriptions.

scale.notes: Per-device database; the server side scales through Couchbase Server or Capella.

strengths: SQL++ queries with joins and full-text search on the device
Production-grade sync with channels, conflict resolvers and access control via Sync Gateway
Peer-to-peer replication between devices without a server (Enterprise)
On-device vector search for local AI features
Backed by a vendor with enterprise support and long-lived releases
weaknesses: Sync only targets Couchbase Server or Capella, so the backend is fixed
Encryption, vector search and P2P sync require the paid Enterprise Edition
Heavier binary and API surface than lightweight mobile stores
useCases: Field-service and retail apps that must work offline for hours
Airline, logistics and healthcare apps with intermittent connectivity
Edge deployments syncing to a central Couchbase cluster
notIdealFor: Apps whose backend is Postgres or another non-Couchbase store
Hobby projects needing a tiny dependency
